name: Joseph Knight Sr.
role: Early supporter of Joseph Smith from Colesville, New York
dateNote: Section 12 came in May 1829, when he brought supplies to Harmony; he was baptized on 28 June 1830.
importance: Joseph Knight Sr. was a farmer and miller who had hired Joseph Smith in 1826. In May 1829 he brought paper and food to Harmony so translation could go on, and section 12 answered his question about his duty. Section 23 tells him to pray vocally and join the Church. His family formed the core of the Colesville branch, which moved to Thompson, Ohio, and then to Jackson County, Missouri, in 1831.
connections: His wife Polly died in Missouri on 7 August 1831, the day section 59 was given; his son Newel Knight led the Colesville branch.

sources.title: Joseph Knight Sr., Joseph Smith Papers biography

reviewNote: JSP gives birth as 3 Nov. 1772; Wikipedia gives 26 Nov. 1772 (year agrees). Death 2 Feb. 1847 at Mount Pisgah, Iowa. Bare “Knight” left out because it names Newel Knight in 52, 54 and 56.
